title: Headcount
context: How many employees are on file?
task: Set result to the number of rows in employees.

title: Columns
task: Set result to the list of column names of employees.

title: Active employees
task: Set result to the employees rows where status == 'Active'.

title: Active count
task: Set result to the number of employees with status 'Active' (an int).

title: Name and level
task: Set result to a DataFrame with just name and level from employees.

title: Senior staff
task: Set result to employees whose level is 'L4' or 'L5'.

title: Remote workers
task: Set result to the names (a Series) of employees with remote == 1.

title: Average salary
task: Set result to the mean salary rounded to 2 decimals (blanks are ignored by mean).

title: Highest salary
task: Set result to the maximum salary (an int).

title: Total payroll
task: Set result to the sum of salary across all employees (an int; blanks ignored).

title: Employees per level
task: Set result to a Series of counts per level (value_counts).

title: Gender split
task: Set result to a Series of counts per gender.

title: Distinct managers
task: Set result to the number of distinct non-blank manager_id values (an int).

title: Headcount per department
task: Set result to a Series of employee counts per dept_id (groupby size).

title: Average salary per level
task: Set result to a Series of mean salary per level, rounded to 0 decimals, sorted by level.

title: Top 5 earners
task: Set result to the 5 highest-paid employees (name, salary), sorted by salary descending.

title: Hire year
task: Set result to employees with an added column hire_year = year of hire_date.

title: Hired in 2020
task: Set result to the number of employees hired in 2020 (an int).

title: Monthly salary
task: Set result to employees with a column monthly = salary / 12 rounded to 0 decimals.

title: Seniority flag
task: Set result to employees with a column band = 'Senior' if level in ('L4','L5') else 'Staff'.

title: Missing salaries
task: Set result to the number of employees with a missing salary (an int).

title: Women in Engineering... by dept_id
task: Set result to employees who are gender 'F' and dept_id == 1.

title: Youngest age
task: Set result to the minimum age (an int).

title: Department names
task: Set result to the list of dept names from departments.

title: Bengaluru departments
task: Set result to the departments rows where location == 'Bengaluru'.

title: Number of reviews
task: Set result to the number of rows in reviews.

title: Average rating
task: Set result to the mean review rating rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Promotions count
task: Set result to the total number of promotions (sum of promoted) as an int.

title: Total leave days
task: Set result to the sum of days in the leave table (an int).

title: Sick leave rows
task: Set result to the number of leave rows where type == 'Sick' (an int).

title: Average rating per year
task: Set result to a Series of mean rating per review year, rounded to 2 decimals, sorted by year.

title: First names
task: Set result to a Series of first names (text before the first space) for all employees.

title: Attrition count
task: Set result to the number of employees with status 'Left' (an int).

title: Annual leave estimate
task: Set result to employees with a column annual_leave = 18 (a constant column).
